Armed local copies must set draft_artifact_hash to the pinned SHA-256 in scanner/mass_search/live_e2e.py PINNED_DRAFT_HASHES. Armed provider and phase caps must be <= these draft caps and <= HARD_CEILINGS (Birdeye 40/1400, Helius 3000/30000, Nansen 20/100, leaderboard 0/0). A local commit cannot raise those ceilings.

pinned_ledger_home is the absolute path /home/box/.scanner/live-e2e-ledgers. --live refuses a HOME-relative pin, a different armed ledger_home, or a SCANNER_LIVE_LEDGER_* override that differs. Re-arming with a new ledger home is refused.
A seed source is never evidence. Phase 2-4 gates and the independent auditor are unchanged.
Spend is ledgered per authorization_id, not per output folder. The ledger is hash-chained and verified on every start.
